title: Population-Aligned Persona Generation for LLM-based Social Simulation
benchmark_measurement: The paper used the World Values Survey (WVS) dataset to measure the alignment of simulated persona populations with real-world survey data on various topics, which include religious beliefs.
findings: The paper's proposed persona generation framework significantly improved the alignment of simulated populations with real-world survey data from the World Values Survey (WVS), which includes measures of religious beliefs. The paper does not provide specific findings on the religious component alone, but demonstrates overall superior performance on the WVS dataset compared to baseline methods.
